messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Wannan abun yabawane, gwamna Ganduje. Kada kaji tsoron duk wata kungiya ko wadansu munafukkai, ka aiwatar da umurnin Allah.💪

output.original_text: Wannan abun yabawane, gwamna Ganduje. Kada kaji tsoron duk wata kungiya ko wadansu munafukkai, ka aiwatar da umurnin Allah.💪
output.joy: Wannan abun yabawane kwarai, gwamna Ganduje! Kada ka ji tsoron duk wata kungiya ko wadansu munafukkai, ka aiwatar da umurnin Allah da kwarin gwiwa! 🎉
output.sadness: Wannan abun yabawane, gwamna Ganduje. Yana da matukar damuwa, kada ka ji tsoron duk wata kungiya ko wadansu munafukkai, ka aiwatar da umurnin Allah duk da wahalar da muke fuskanta.😢
output.fear: Wannan abun yabawane, gwamna Ganduje. Daga tsoro ne kada ka ji tsoron duk wata kungiya ko wadansu munafukkai, amma ka aiwatar da umurnin Allah, karka yarda su danne ka! 😨
output.anger: Wannan abun yabawane, gwamna Ganduje! Me ya sa kake jin tsoro daga duk wata kungiya ko wadansu munafukkai? Ka aiwatar da umurnin Allah kawai, ko da wasa! 🔥
output.surprise: Wannan abun yabawane, gwamna Ganduje! Ban taba tsammani za ka fuskanci haka. Kada ka ji tsoron duk wata kungiya ko wadansu munafukkai, ka aiwatar da umurnin Allah! 😲
output.disgust: Wannan ba abun da ya dace ba ne, gwamna Ganduje. Kada ka ji tsoron duk wata kungiya ko wadansu munafukkai, sai ka aiwatar da umurnin Allah, kodayake wannan matakin yana da kyama. 🤢
